These unique slip-ons represent 200 years of tradition. A style of round-toe shoe worn in northern Italy, the Friulana is made from silk velvet, in a region known for its fine velvet. It’s lined in soft calfskin and features a tonal grosgrain trim. The rubber tread is hand-stitched to the felt sole with waxed twine — stitching, rather than glue, allows for maximum breathability, and emphasizes the shoe's classic “gloved” look; it takes a full hour to complete 200 stitches. All the materials are Italian, and the shoe is entirely crafted in northern Italy. Slip a pair on to channel summer in Venice vibes.

Hit the road—even when it veers off-trail—in these easy-wearing, adventure-craving travel shorts we like to call our ATBs (All Terrain Bottoms). Equipped with multiple, strategic pockets for securing your goods on-the-go, whether through airport TSA or back at the campsite with the fam, the ATB Shorts are crafted with durable NetPlus® recycled nylon made from fishing nets and spandex that will stand up to any activity in the wild. C0 DWR (perfluorocarbon-free) water-resistance.
